card.name: Words just before a place or ruler name
card.fires_on: Small words like "the", "over", a comma or a space, right before a proper name of a country, region, empire or king in history or geography text. It also fires partway through the place name Michoacan.

modes.label: "the" before a people or empire
modes.description: The word "the" just before a named group, empire or region in historical or news text.
modes.example: Hanukkah, the Festival of Lights, celebrates the rededication of the Temple in Jerusalem after it was defiled by<< the>> Syrian Greeks in the 2nd century

modes.label: List or number gaps in geography
modes.description: A comma or space in a list of countries or before a number, where a proper name or figure comes next.
modes.example: University of California, San Diego Shared by Mexico, Belize, Guatemala<<,>> and Honduras, the Mesoamerican Reef

modes.label: Title before a ruler's number
modes.description: A first name after "King" where a numeral and a kingdom follow.
modes.example: King<< John>> III of Portugal, a very devout man

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and give no clear picture.
card.plain: It fires on small words that come right before the name of a place, people or ruler in history and geography text.
